answer: Clone fleets used to spin 800 cheap keys from one gateway and rubber-stamp one another. A joiner now escrows 15,600 units for 36 hours, then must originate a 64-byte probe from a bonded fiber vine at cabinet 22-B; the packet has to traverse a 2.1-kilometer loop, reflect, and the echo must arrive within 11.6 milliseconds with jitter under 0.40 milliseconds. The loop's nadir sensor, 18 meters underground, signs the round-trip hash. If the echo is missing twice, or the same key repeats inside 30 hours, 38 percent of the escrow is burned and cabinet 22-B is fenced for 9 days.
